title: ROTC Cadets Marching Outdoors, 1966 B&W Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white photo stamped FEB 1966 depicting a long line of ROTC cadets marching in formation down a sidewalk on a sunlit campus or public park. The men are wearing formal dress uniforms and side caps. On the left grass lawn, a man in a business suit is taking a picture with a hand-held camera, while other spectators line the walkway in the background. Captured during the height of the Vietnam War period, this snapshot highlights military instruction and ceremonial drills on American college grounds during the 1960s.
